==Description==
The '''Coal Nametag''' is a nametag that could be obtained from the [[Quests#Naughty List|Naughty List!]] quest, which required 50 [[Evil Elf (Krampus Frosthold)|Evil Elves]] to be killed.

The '''Coal Nametag''' has grey and black vertical gradient text and a black outline. Grey and black smoke appears behind the text, alongside coal. It also has a secret variant, which has a 0.1% chance to appear. This variant has grey text and outline, alongside a white background with coal behind it. Getting this variant used to give you a badge.

==Trivia==
*This is the only nametag to have multiple variants.
*The coal that appears on this nametag is the [https://minecraft.wiki/w/Coal Coal] from ''Minecraft''.
